title: 第23章 少女情血色剑坠第24章 临顿悟姗姗来迟
content_zh:
“无极剑法第一式：天地一气斩！”
只见无数剑气汇聚于一道，瞬间破空劈下。
“轰！！！”
旁边的一个巨石顿时炸裂开来，地面出现一道沟壑，赫然是劈的。刚刚林玄只是按照剑法驱使灵气，可以算是随意一击，居然都有如此威力，可见这天地一气斩有多厉害！
“这就是无极剑法第一式？好强！”
林玄看着自己刚刚随意使出的无极剑法第一式，微微愣住。
“若是之前在百兽林的时候有这种剑法，根本就不需要秘术就能斩破那碧潭幽蟒的防御！这一剑的实力，应该足以对付天武境界强者了吧？”
“果然这等强大的剑法跟秘术一样，需要耗费极大的灵力，刚刚这一剑，居然又抽掉了自己一小半的力量。”
林玄微微苦笑，剑法招式太强也是痛苦，因为根本使不出几剑，你的灵力就耗空了。
“无极剑法只能作为底牌存在，不能随意使出，有着无极剑法和自己掌握的秘术，对付谢清影应该不成问题。”
林玄目光坚定，紧接着，继续复习巩固剑法。
......
天雷峰另一处洞府，正是祝红菱的住处，此时她依旧趴在桌子上，望着远处练剑的林玄。
祝红菱也不知自己为何了，当对师兄林玄放下成见甚至有些仰慕之后，每次面对林玄的时候都会有的语无伦次。
刚刚送东西跑回来，更是有些脸红心跳。
“我这是怎么了？”
祝红菱摇头自问，俏眉微皱。
微风轻轻拂过粉嫩的脸颊，她的目光依旧盯着远处林玄刻苦修炼的身影。
这时候，一个大腹便便的身形不知何时已经进入了洞府内，赫然是祝天虹。
看着发呆的女儿，祝天虹摸着八字胡微微叹息。

这一叹息，瞬间就把发呆中的祝红菱惊醒过来。
“父......父亲，您什么时候来的？”祝红菱刚刚直勾勾盯着林玄那边看，此时像是偷东西被发现了一般。
“早就到了，女儿啊，你这又是何苦呢。”祝天虹叹气道。
“玄儿就像是那暂落枝头的雄鹰，如今已经展翅，必要高飞！无极门甚至是南域都留不住他。”
“父亲，什么何苦？什么高飞？”祝红菱扮傻卖萌，假装听不懂。
“刚刚我都看到了，玄儿这两天备战之际，他的一举一动我都在观察，刚刚你送东西的那一幕我都看到咯，自己送的还拿你老父亲出来当挡箭牌。”祝天虹瞥了她一眼，吹了一下八字胡调侃说道。
祝红菱心中藏了许久的秘密被父亲祝天虹拆穿，顿时羞恼道：“父亲！您在说什么呢......我听不懂！”
说话间，祝红菱不自觉低下了头。
“父亲最怕最担心的事情还是来了，这都八年过去了，你不是一直讨厌你师兄吗？”祝天虹摸着女儿的头，心中依旧在叹息。
他早知林玄非池中之物，女儿不喜林玄。八年来，祝红菱虽然一直厌恶林玄，但只要做的不过火，他不会去过问。反而担心的是，女儿祝红菱会喜欢上林玄，那样的话，估计只能单相思，哀愁终身。
content_en:
"The first form of Wuji Sword Technique: slashing the heaven and earth in one breath!"
I saw countless sword energy gathering together, breaking through the air and slashing down instantly.
"Boom!!!"
A huge boulder next to it suddenly exploded, and a ravine appeared on the ground, which was obviously split. Just now, Lin Xuan just used his spiritual energy according to the sword technique. It could be regarded as a random strike, but it was so powerful. This shows how powerful this heaven and earth strike is!
"Is this the first form of Wuji Sword Technique? So powerful!"
Lin Xuan was slightly stunned as he looked at the first move of Wuji Sword Technique that he had just casually used.
"If I had had this kind of sword technique in the Hundred Beasts Forest before, I wouldn't have needed any secret techniques to break through the defense of the Bitan Nether Python! The strength of this sword should be enough to deal with a strong person in the Tianwu Realm, right?"
"Sure enough, such a powerful sword technique is the same as the secret technique, which requires a huge amount of spiritual energy. The sword just now actually took away a small half of my strength."
Lin Xuan smiled bitterly. It's painful to have too strong sword moves, because you can't use a few swords at all, and your spiritual power will be exhausted.
"The Wuji Sword Technique can only be used as a trump card and cannot be used at will. With the Wuji Sword Technique and the secret technique that I have mastered, it should not be a problem to deal with Xie Qingying."
Lin Xuan's eyes were firm, and he continued to review and consolidate his sword skills.
...
Another cave in Tianlei Peak is where Zhu Hongling lives. At this time, she is still lying on the table, looking at Lin Xuan who is practicing swordsmanship in the distance.
Zhu Hongling didn't know why. After she let go of her prejudice against her senior brother Lin Xuan and even had some admiration for him, she would become incoherent every time she faced Lin Xuan.
I just ran back from delivering something, and I was even blushing and heartbeating.
"What's wrong with me?"
Zhu Hongling shook her head and asked herself, her pretty eyebrows frowning slightly.
The breeze gently blew over her pink cheeks, and her eyes were still staring at Lin Xuan's hard-working figure in the distance.
At this time, a pot-bellied figure had entered the cave at some point, and it was Zhu Tianhong.
Looking at his dazed daughter, Zhu Tianhong touched his mustache and sighed slightly.
This sigh instantly woke Zhu Hongling out of his daze.
"Father...Father, when did you come?" Zhu Hongling had just stared straight at Lin Xuan, as if she had been caught stealing something.
"We've been here a long time ago, my daughter, why are you doing this?" Zhu Tianhong sighed.
"Xuan'er is like the eagle that has fallen off the branches for a while. Now it has spread its wings and must fly high! Neither the Wuji Sect nor even the Southern Territory can keep him."
"Father, why bother? What are you talking about?" Zhu Hongling acted silly and cute, pretending not to understand.
"I saw everything just now. When Xuan'er was preparing for the war these two days, I was observing every move he made. I saw the scene where you gave something to me just now. You even used your old father as a shield when you gave it to yourself." Zhu Tianhong glanced at her and blew his mustache and said teasingly.
The secret that Zhu Hongling had hidden in her heart for a long time was exposed by her father Zhu Tianhong, and she immediately said in embarrassment: "Father! What are you talking about...I don't understand!"
While speaking, Zhu Hongling lowered her head unconsciously.
"The thing that father is most afraid of and worries about has come. It's been eight years, haven't you always hated your senior brother?" Zhu Tianhong touched her daughter's head, still sighing in her heart.
He had known that Lin Xuan was not a creature of the pond, and his daughter did not like Lin Xuan. Although Zhu Hongling had always hated Lin Xuan for the past eight years, he would not question him as long as he did not go too far. What I am worried about instead is that my daughter Zhu Hongling will fall in love with Lin Xuan. In that case, she will probably only have unrequited love and be sad for the rest of her life.
